name: table
label: Table
description: Select the table or database view to report calendar events from.

name: reportSource
label: Predefined conditions
description: Filter the table based on a predefined condition from the list.

name: encodedQuery
label: Filter table
description: Add or edit conditions to filter the specified table.

name: startDateField
label: Start date field
description: Select the field to report on as the starting event.

name: endDateField
label: End date field
description: Select the field to report on as the ending event.

name: eventDisplayFields
label: Event display fields
description: Select the fields to appear on all calendar events.

name: lineClamp
label: Line of truncation
description: The number of lines the header can use before it’s truncated. Long headers will be cut off with an ellipsis after the selected number of lines.

name: headingLevel
label: Heading level
description: HTML heading tag level of the header title (H1 to H6).

name: headingVariant
label: Use large font size
description: Defines the styles used to render the header title

name: componentDescription
label: Component description
description: Enter a description for the component. 250 character limit.

name: viewType
label: Default view
description: Select the view you want to apply as default

name: eventColor
label: Event color
description: Enter the color reference (CSS custom property) to use for all the events

name: refreshRequest
label: Refresh requested
description: A string that can be passed down to trigger a data refresh. Refresh will be triggered only if the new value of this property is different from the previous one.
